Interface ClientCommandVisitor

All Known Implementing Classes:
GameController
public interface ClientCommandVisitor
Top-level visitor over ClientCommand: dispatches the three families (GameCommand, LobbyCommand, HeartbeatCommand) without knowing the concrete implementations. The network endpoints use it to choose whether to enqueue a game command or delegate a lobby command to the LobbyManager; the GameController uses it to dispatch between network events and game commands.

The second-level visitors are GameCommandVisitor and LobbyCommandVisitor.
